fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

The `bluebones_image()` function in `magic/image_fetcher.py` built URLs for `http://magic.bluebones.net/proxies/index2.php` — a service that now returns HTTP 500 for all requests. The function was never called from any live code path (Scryfall handles all image fetching), but it still existed as dead, misleading code. A comment in `discordbot/unit_test.py` also referenced bluebones as a reason for using Nalathni Dragon as a test case.

## What changed

- Deleted `bluebones_image()` (3 lines) from `magic/image_fetcher.py`.
- Updated the outdated comment in `discordbot/unit_test.py` to accurately reflect that Scryfall is now the sole image source.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit discordbot` — 845 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected

Fixes #12421
